description: The golden spacing scale (spacers 1-11 plus half-N and double-N) with exact values, px and CSS variable names, as used by goldenratio.app and the tailwindcss-golden-ratio plugin. With default options it also returns the rounded cheatsheet table from goldenratio.app/#/spacing.

prefix.description: Plugin prefix option, only changes tailwind_key (true = "gr-").

root_font_px.description: Root font size for px conversion of rem/em values (default 16).

spacer_base.description: theme.goldenRatio.spacerBase: the size of spacer 6 (default 1.5, as on goldenratio.app).

name: golden_spacing
title: Golden spacing scale
